definition: A state of stubborn disagreement or conflict with someone.
author: Victor Hugo
quote: It represented the minute at loggerheads on the one hand with the monarchical centuries, on the other hand with eternal right.
example_sentence: The neighbours have been at loggerheads over the hedge for years.
